result_text:
Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now counts as test code, whatever follows it, including non-ASCII characters and punctuation.

**Change:** `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, lines 393–394. The two folder rules changed from a character whitelist (`[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+`) to "anything except a path separator" (`[^/\\]*`). The `/` anchors keep the match inside one folder name, so `remock/` and `src/main/java/` don't match. `mockapi/` and `_mock.*` files are untouched.

**Verification:** I ran a temporary test, since deleted, against the convention list. It passed for the elasticsearch `inference/mock/` path, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe`, `mock模拟`, backslash paths, and all the previously-matched folders (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`). It correctly rejected `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java`, `mockery.java`, and `src/mock.java`. The existing `SourceFileFilterTest` (6 tests) also passes. The working tree shows only the one modified file.

I didn't run a full module test suite, only the two classes above.
